descriptions.d24l_textbox_back_panel_802c1248: Builds a text box back panel: loads 'FE.Textbox.Back' (resource type base+28) through a handle constructed from the name, stores the cast mesh retained at +36 releasing the previous one, sets scale (500,500,1) through virtual slot +84, clears the colour to (0,0,0,0) via 0x80173df0, sets +40 to 10.0 and subscribes the object to the cached message 0x804b1068 with handler slot +68.
